data.name: Aazaad
data.gender_notes: Aazaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aazaad is derived from the Arabic root ‘A-Z-D’, which means 'to free, deliver, or liberate'. In Islamic context, the name signifies the one who is mighty and powerful, as well as one who is free from sin and its consequences. The name is associated with the idea of being free from worldly desires and attaining spiritual liberation. It is a name of great significance in Islamic and spiritual traditions, as it represents the ultimate goal of human life - to seek Allah's pleasure and attain eternal freedom and peace.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aazaad is a symbol of spiritual strength, courage, and the pursuit of freedom from the bondage of worldly desires.
data.etymology: Aazaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freedom, Liberation, Mighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aazaad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
